title: Client portal branding
summary: Law firms can now put their own logo and button colours on the workspace their clients see.
body_markdown:
If you invite clients onto Parachute, they can now see your firm’s brand instead of ours.


- Your logo sits at the top of your clients’ sidebar.
- Your colours appear on their buttons and links.
- Your firm’s name and icon show in their browser tab.


Turn it on under Firm settings > Branding. Upload your logo, pick your colours and check the live preview before you save.


[Read more about branding](https://help.goparachute.ai/features/branding/)
